section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study examining caregiver eating messages and their associations with body attitudes and eating behaviors in young adult women and men. Two studies (Study 1: N=238; Study 2: N=288) were conducted to develop and validate the Caregiver Eating Messages Scale, which measures restrictive/critical messages and pressure to eat messages. Both factors were positively related to women's BMI, and restrictive/critical messages were positively related to men's BMI.
